Dyskinesia severity endpoint rather than DA cell survival.

CEF 8 g/kg orally for 5 d BEFORE 6-OHDA, explicitly to induce gut dysbiosis, not as a neuroprotectant. Worsened motor deficits and significantly reduced striatal TH vs 6-OHDA alone. CEF alone did not affect motor function. Behaviour n=8-12; western blot n=4-6. EXCLUDED from the efficacy stratum; reported as a route- and dose-dependent safety signal.
